title: combvec
summary: Generate all column combinations from numeric matrices.
description: `combvec(A,B,...)` returns a numeric matrix whose columns are all combinations of the input matrix columns, with the first input varying fastest.
behaviors: Inputs must be finite numeric scalars or 2-D matrices.
The output row count is the sum of the input row counts, and the output column count is the product of the input column counts.
Very large outputs are rejected before allocation.

examples.output: `M` is 3-by-4, stacking one column from each input per output column.

gpu_residency: `combvec` materializes a host numeric matrix in this slice; provider-resident Cartesian generation remains future GPU work.
